title: Memory Care Payments, Returned Payments and Late Fees
content:
The memory care account under the Memory Care Residency Agreement shows the amount owed: monthly rates, add-ons and fees book in; payments and credits book out; a negative balance is a credit balance. Payments come from the family, the representative or a long-term care insurer.

## Practice

1. **Posting payments.** Payments are posted once per payment instrument and applied to the oldest charge first.
2. **Returned payments.** A returned payment is reinstated on the account referencing the payment entry it reverses, and carries the returned payment fee.
3. **Grace period.** A late fee may be assessed only after 10 calendar days have passed since the monthly charges for that billing period were posted. The grace period ends at the end of the day equal to the posting date plus 10 calendar days, and a late fee may be assessed only on a later date.
4. **Amount.** The late fee is the greater of 85.00 and 1.5 percent of the period's past-due amount, the percentage amount rounded to the cent half up. No late fee is assessed when the past-due amount is below 150.00, or while an insurer billed directly has not yet paid that period.
5. **Past-due amount.** The past-due amount of a billing period is measured at the end of the last grace day: the monthly rate and monthly add-on charges of that billing period, less payments and credits applied oldest first.
6. **Once per period.** At most one late fee is assessed per residency per billing period.

## Grace period boundary (hypothetical dates)

Monthly charges for the billing period posted on 1 May.

| Date | Late fee may be assessed |
|---|---|
| 11 May (the last grace day, ending at the end of that day) | No |
| 12 May | Yes, if the other conditions are met |

## Late fee amounts (hypothetical past-due amounts)

| Past-due amount at the end of the last grace day | 1.5 percent of it | Late fee |
|---|---|---|
| 149.99 | - | None (below 150.00) |
| 150.00 | 2.25 | 85.00 |
| 5000.00 | 75.00 | 85.00 |
| 6000.00 | 90.00 | 90.00 |
| 7200.00 | 108.00 | 108.00 |

## Conditions together

| Grace period over | Past-due amount 150.00 or more | Insurer billed directly and has not yet paid that period | Late fee already assessed for the period | Late fee may be assessed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes |
| No | any | any | any | No |
| any | No | any | any | No |
| any | any | Yes | any | No |
| any | any | any | Yes | No |
